newsitem.title: USA: Sears Q2 net income falls after items.
newsitem.headline: Sears Q2 net income falls after items.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: '97 Q2 net includes charge of $320 million, or $0.80 a share, for estimated cost to settle claims with class-action plaintiffs and attorneys general from 50 states related to Sears' handling of debt reaffirmation agreements.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: '97 six mos includes gain of $74 million, or $0.18 a share, for the accounting change. Also includes loss of $36 million, or $0.09 a share, resulting from the sale of 60 percent of the outstanding shares of Sears, Roebuck de Mexico SA de CV to Grupo Carso SA de CV for cash proceeds of $103 million. The deal reduced the company's ownership of Sears Mexico to 15.5 percent.
Per-share earnings include payment of dividends for preferred shares.
Company's full name is Sears, Roebuck and Co.
